title: vector.completions.response.streaming.AgentCompletionChunk
description:
A streaming agent completion chunk from a single agent within a vector completion.

The `index` field is used to correlate chunks belonging to the same
underlying completion when accumulating via [`push`](Self::push).

continuation.description: Continuation state for multi-turn conversations (only present in the final chunk).

error.description: Error details if this completion failed.

index.description: Index used to correlate chunks from the same completion.

usage.description: Token usage (only present in the final chunk).
